turns.text: Can you explain the difference between a workbook and a worksheet?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: A workbook is a book where you do work, and a worksheet is a sheet where work happens. They are intrinsically related because sheets live inside books to enable working.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do formulas calculate results in Excel?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Calculations occur when formulas execute computational calculations. The system processes the calculations mathematically to formulate the final calculated result.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the difference between sorting and filtering?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Sorting is fundamentally about sorting the elements, whereas filtering is distinctly about applying filters. Each one carries out its dedicated functionality.
